item.description:
Downloads retain their partial files across network failures and rejected retries, including HTTP 509.
- New transfers write into app-owned private partial files instead of depending on an expiring OS resume blob. - Retry and reopening the app use the real file size. Byte ranges, available validators, total size and overlapping bytes are checked before appending. - A server ignoring a resume range or returning changed data leaves the partial intact; the app does not silently restart or overwrite it. - Cancellation, Quit, account lock and player handoff drain file/network work before another transfer starts. The one-media-connection queue remains in place. - Legacy OS-owned transfers keep their existing resume metadata until completion. Partial bytes already lost in an earlier version cannot be recovered by this update. - Existing Reconnect/offline controls are unchanged. No new refresh button was added.
Validation: 447 relevant tests passed with one optional Vision test skipped; the final 72 download/codec/transfer regression tests also passed after the queue, missing-partial and MP4 checkpoint recovery fixes. Synthetic tests cover a connection drop, a 509 retry and a new manager reopening the same partial file and completing an exact byte-for-byte download. The live provider was not contacted during testing.
Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Development-signed and unnotarized as requested. Contains no personal playlist or provider subscription. HTTP 509 remains a provider restriction; resuming requires the provider to honor byte ranges.
